jsonConfig.c9QLFilter:
select *, date(datetime) as date2,
substring_after(substring_after(SUBSTRING_BEFORE(location,')'),' '),' ') as latitude,
substring_before(SUBSTRING_AFTER(location,'('),' ') as longitude,
year(datetime) as year, month(datetime) as month,
date_format(datetime,MMM-yy) as month_str, 
date_format(datetime,yyyy) as year_num,
case when crimetype is null then description else crimetype end as type_tmp, 
array(description) as description,
policebeat as pbeat_tmp,
~State, ~location, ~policebeat
where datetime >= $c9_thisyear
group by casenumber
order by datetime desc;

select *,  
	case when type_tmp like Burg - auto or type_tmp like Burglary-Auto then BURGLARY-AUTO
		 when type_tmp like VEHICLE THEFT - AUTO then STOLEN VEHICLE
		 else type_tmp end as type, 
	case when length(pbeat_tmp) =2 then concat("0",pbeat_tmp) else pbeat_tmp end as policebeat,
	~pbeat_tmp, ~type_tmp
